goal: Users can inspect one renderer-neutral semantic outline and paper-like preview from the saved Markdown snapshot, synchronize selection with the editor, and see explicit validation-blocked and unsupported states without any Word pagination claim.
non_goals: Do not invoke the DOCX renderer, create DOCX/OOXML objects, parse Office output, or claim exact Word pagination.
Do not change parser syntax or IDs, validation rules, template schema/resolver precedence, compiler numbering, bibliography semantics, renderer behavior, or DOCX output.
Do not implement build progress, cancellation, output replacement, final packaging, AI, accounts, database, telemetry, autosave, or multi-document state.
expected_evidence: Strict RED and GREEN proving preview_service reuses parse/validate/compile, skips compile on fatal validation, and never calls renderer or writes output

Golden mapper coverage for outline IDs/lines, compiler order, numbering labels, inline references/citations/footnotes, cover, TOC, sections, lists, figures, tables, equations, listings, algorithms, bibliography, and unsupported RenderNode fallback
Adapter and TypeScript DTO tests proving preview responses are JSON-safe, versioned, complete, and reject malformed nested values
Reducer tests for preview loading, validation-blocked state, template refresh, stale suppression, and shared selection
React tests for outline/preview rendering, keyboard and pointer activation, editor line focus, diagnostics markers, empty/blocked/unsupported states, and persistent pagination disclaimer
Static tests forbidding docx, lxml, renderers, compiler, parser, validator, HTTP, Tauri, and filesystem imports from frontend preview modules
Frontend unit/typecheck/lint/build/E2E and focused/full Python regression evidence
Ruff, pip check, Cargo fmt/test/check, strict OpenSpec, SpecNav entry, CodeGraph, JSON, and whitespace evidence
Task report, dedicated spec review, and dedicated quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Every content item has a semantic ID or source line.
Inspection success guarantees a render plan.
Typed preview data represents exact Word pages.
Unknown RenderNode values may be dropped.
Completion order is sufficient stale-result protection.
stop_condition: Stop if preview needs renderer/OOXML/output access, direct adapter or React compiler coupling, semantic rule changes outside allowed files, leaked Python/private objects, silently dropped unsupported content, or no deterministic shared selection contract.
